body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Madrid, Spain. The listing gives its length as 1.5 – 2 hours, over a route of about 2 km. It starts at Outside the Goya entrance to the Prado Museum, Calle de Felipe IV, 3. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to the Prado Museum. There is no live guide: the tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Ekaterina as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Discover the wonders of the renowned Prado Museum with this captivating in-app audio tour. Immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of art and history as you traverse the halls of one of the world's most esteemed cultural treasures.
>
> The Museo Nacional del Prado, is one of the most renowned art museums in the world. It is famous for its extensive collection of European art which spans from the 12th to the 20th century and includes works by renowned artists such as Francisco Goya, Diego Velázquez, Titian, and Peter Paul Rubens, among many others.
>
> The tour serves as a perfect guide covering all the must-see artworks and gems of the collection. Unlock the secrets behind the masterpieces as the tour takes you on a mesmerizing journey through the Prado's vast collection. Delve into the genius of artists, as their brushstrokes come to life through engaging narration and insightful commentary.
>
> The Prado Museum's legacy spans centuries, and this audio tour encapsulates its essence, breathing new life into its timeless masterpieces. Embark on a transformative journey that will transport you to the heart of artistic excellence and discover the Prado Museum like never before.
>
> Note! This tour is not affiliated with the Prado Museum but is provided by an independent creator. The ticket is included for the customer's convenience and at no charge.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €25.31. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 254 ratings and 83 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
